study_area.name: Delhi NCR
study_area.boundary_source: approximate NCR outline (SPEC §1.2) with nearest-HQ (Voronoi) districts

features.name: ndvi
features.label: NDVI
features.description: Normalised Difference Vegetation Index; greener, denser vegetation cools the surface by transpiration and shading.

features.name: ndwi
features.label: NDWI
features.description: McFeeters Normalised Difference Water Index (green vs NIR); high values mark open water and wet surfaces.

features.name: ndbi
features.label: NDBI
features.description: Normalised Difference Built-up Index (SWIR vs NIR); high values mark built-up and bare, dry surfaces.

features.name: elevation
features.label: Elevation
features.description: Mean terrain height above sea level; air and surface temperature fall with altitude.

features.name: slope
features.label: Slope
features.description: Mean terrain slope; steep ridges (Aravalli) change solar exposure and land use.

features.name: aspect_sin
features.label: Aspect (east-west)
features.description: Sine of terrain aspect: +1 east-facing, -1 west-facing slopes.
features.source: SRTM GL1 (30 m), sin(aspect) averaged at 30 m

features.name: aspect_cos
features.label: Aspect (north-south)
features.description: Cosine of terrain aspect: +1 north-facing, -1 south-facing (sun-exposed) slopes.
features.source: SRTM GL1 (30 m), cos(aspect) averaged at 30 m

features.name: ntl
features.label: Night-time lights
features.description: Log night-time radiance; proxy for urban intensity and anthropogenic heat release.
features.source: VIIRS DNB monthly (2015+) / DMSP-OLS harmonised by isotonic regression (2010)

features.name: log_pop
features.label: Population density (log)
features.description: Log of residents per km²; proxy for building density and human heat emission.

features.name: frac_impervious
features.label: Impervious cover
features.description: Share of the cell covered by built-up / impervious surfaces.

features.name: frac_forest
features.label: Tree cover
features.description: Share of the cell covered by trees / forest.

features.name: frac_water
features.label: Water
features.description: Share of the cell covered by open water (rivers, canals, lakes).

features.name: frac_cropland
features.label: Cropland
features.description: Share of the cell under cultivation.

features.name: frac_barren
features.label: Barren land
features.description: Share of the cell that is bare soil, sand or rock.

features.name: lm_pd
features.label: Patch density
features.description: Number of land-cover patches (8-connected) per 100 ha; higher = more fragmented mosaic.
features.source: FRAGSTATS PD on fine land cover

features.name: lm_ed
features.label: Edge density
features.description: Length of boundaries between different land-cover classes per hectare.
features.source: FRAGSTATS ED on fine land cover

features.name: lm_contag
features.label: Contagion
features.description: Aggregation of land-cover classes (0 = maximally interspersed, 100 = single contiguous class).
features.source: FRAGSTATS CONTAG on fine land cover

synthetic_truth.formula: lst = base(43.0) + offset[year] + 4.0*frac_barren + 1.2*frac_cropland + 2.5*frac_impervious**0.8 + 1.5*frac_impervious*(ndvi<0.2) - 5.0*clip(ndvi,0,0.28)/0.28 - 3.5*(1-exp(-frac_water/0.08)) + 1.5*ndbi - 0.006*(elevation-220) + 0.25*ntl + N_spatial(sd 0.7, ~8 km) + N_white(sd 0.4)

interaction.description: extra warming of impervious surface where NDVI < 0.2

synthetic_truth.note: Features not in the formula act only through correlation with planted drivers.

bootstrap.block_size_source: spatial-CV XGBoost residual correlogram (< 0.1 beyond ~22 km)
bootstrap.ci_method_description: bias-corrected percentile interval: the 2.5/97.5 replicate percentiles shifted by (full-data estimate - replicate median); always contains the estimate

notes: Land cover comes from different products per epoch (GLC_FCS30D, ESA WorldCover, Dynamic World); class definitions and accuracies differ, so part of the land-cover change is product inconsistency.

DMSP-OLS (2010) saturates in urban cores and has no on-board calibration: 2010 DN are intercalibrated to F18 2013 with a robust fit on pseudo-invariant pixels and then mapped to VIIRS log radiance by an isotonic regression fitted on DMSP 2013 vs VIIRS 2014; both steps are approximate, so 2010-vs-later night-light differences should not be over-read.
Terra's orbit drifts after 2022 (earlier overpass), biasing 2025 MODIS day LST slightly low.
GHS-POP 2025 is a model projection rescaled to WorldPop 2020, not a census estimate.
SYNTHETIC DATA: every variable is simulated from a planted response; see SYNTHETIC_TRUTH.

SHAP values explain the model, not causal effects. Zone recommendations are model-based counterfactuals (the final model re-evaluated on the zone's cells after a feasible land-cover / NDVI / landscape change); the cooling they report is associated with the change in the model, not a causal effect.

Zones group cells whose predicted anomaly is attributed to the same features in similar amounts (current state relative to the average cell); zone names follow a fixed labelling rule (see zones.json labelling).
In-browser scenarios use a depth-6 surrogate of the final model (see model_web.json fidelity).

Temporal cross-validation scores the spatial anomaly pattern of the held-out last epoch (its epoch-wide mean is removed from the target by design), so it measures pattern transfer, not prediction of the climate offset.
Target is the LST anomaly from each epoch's spatial mean; predictions are converted back to °C by adding epoch_mean.
